title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-03 current SGA working record: SGA 6 complete and SGA 7-I through source page 96
description:
Working SGA translation and source-checking record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record collects existing public SGA translations and the current source-checked SGA 5/6/7 working streams.

Status at a glance. [##########] SGA 5 source-checked stream: complete through page 484; [##########] SGA 6 strict stream: complete through the original source scan, including the terminological index and index of notations at source pages 693-702; [####------] SGA 7-I working stream: source-checked English/French working edition through source page 96.

Latest update. Added SGA 7-I cumulative English and French working readers through source page 96, the matching source-scan slice, TeX sources, render checks, validation manifests, and methodology notes, while retaining the completed SGA 6 source-page-702 readers as the stable SGA 6 surface.
notes: Latest update adds SGA 7-I source-checked English/French cumulative readers through source page 96 plus source-scan witness and validation artifacts; the SGA 6 complete source-page-702 readers remain present.
